definitions.explanation: Appearing natural or effortless, without showing obvious intent or self-consciousness.
Done in a way that doesn't draw attention, often with careful consideration hidden beneath the surface.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はさりげなく{彼女|かのじょ}を{助|たす}けた。
さりげない{気配|きくば}りがうれしかった。
examples.english: I was happy about the subtle thoughtfulness.

examples.japanese: さりげない{会話|かいわ}の{中|なか}で{情報|じょうほう}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I gathered information through casual conversation.

notes:
FORMS:
・さりげない (plain)
・さりげなく (adverbial) - casually, unobtrusively
・さりげなさ (noun) - casualness, subtlety

ETYMOLOGY:
From 然り (さり, "being so") + 気 (け, "air, manner") + ない (negative). Literally "without seeming so," hence "without showing intent."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・さりげない{優|やさ}しさ - understated kindness
・さりげない{気配|きくば}り - subtle consideration
・さりげない{会話|かいわ} - casual conversation
・さりげない{仕草|しぐさ} - casual gesture
・さりげないおしゃれ - effortless style

USAGE NOTES:
This word often carries positive connotations, implying someone is being thoughtful or helpful without making a show of it. The adverbial form さりげなく is very common.
